title: transit: unix_nanos() as i64 wraps in year 2262 (block_cache.rs)
description: block_cache.rs computes unix_nanos() as u128 and casts to i64. The cast wraps silently when the value exceeds i64::MAX, which occurs around year 2262. While not an immediate concern, the wrapping cast is latent undefined behavior. Should use TryFrom or saturate.
